OTR Class A Dry Van Driver
Prairieline Transport is hiring experienced over-the-road drivers out of our Joliet, IL terminal.
What we offer:
Earn 62 to 70 cents per mile based on experience
Home every 10 to 14 days
2024 and newer Freightliner Cascadias, automatic transmissions
$3,000 sign-on bonus paid out over 90 days
Medical, dental and vision insurance after 60 days
What we need:
Valid Class A CDL
At least 12 months of verifiable tractor-trailer experience
Apply online in 5 minutes.
